name: Investor / Rentista Residence Visa

requirements.blocker_text: Requires acquiring at least a 20% share in a Venezuelan business. No fixed minimum investment amount is specified -- eligibility is assessed case by case. Grants a 3-year renewable visa, converting to permanent residency after 2 years and to citizenship after 10 years of continuous residence.
requirements.fix_path: Acquire a 20%+ share in a qualifying Venezuelan business.

requirements.blocker_text: Requires at least USD 1,200/month in foreign-source income (pension or other legal income), plus USD 500/month per accompanying dependent. Grants a 1-year renewable visa, with residency and citizenship pathways similar to the investor route but a lower entry barrier.
requirements.fix_path: Demonstrate USD 1,200/month in qualifying foreign-source income, plus USD 500/month per dependent.

sources.title: IMI Daily -- Venezuela's Inversionista and Rentista residence visa options in the post-Maduro transitional period: thresholds, durations, and the PR/citizenship pathway

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Venezuela). STATUS: DRAFT -- sourced to a single tier-3 investment-migration trade outlet; no SAIME or Ministry of Foreign Affairs government page describing these two visa categories was locatable/fetchable in this build, and this article itself is explicitly framed around the SAME political transition disclosed in ve_visitor_visa.json's notes (Maduro's January 2026 capture, the Rodriguez-led acting government) -- these visa terms may reflect very recent, possibly still-settling policy rather than a long-established program, and should be treated as provisional. dual_citizenship_allowed set true per Venezuela's constitutional Article 34 (see ve_citizenship_naturalisation.json), which appears to apply to naturalized citizens generally rather than being visa-specific. family_can_work left null since the source did not address dependents' independent work rights.
